Each query below is written from the page alone and has not been run. These are the assumptions that could break it:

- `groupBy` with no key modifier groups by the element itself.
- `at 1` on a vector reads softly and answers null.
- `round` rounds halves up (M13 needs 68500.5 to become 68501).
- `contains` works on a vector of strings (M4).
- `parseJson` turns "100000" into a number (M13).
- M14 splits on spaces and strips a trailing "." or ";" instead of matching runs of letters, since the page lists no regex verb.

M1: filter ~(/active) | filter ~(at :email | ne null) | * (/email | lower) | sort
M2: * (/profile/age !| null) | filter ~(type | eq ::number) | :a / | sum | div (a | count) | mul 10 | round | div 10
M3: filter ~(/profile/country !| null | type | eq ::string) | groupBy ~(/profile/country | upper) * count
M4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(/labels * lower | contains "bug") | sort ~([(/priority | mul -1) /id]) | take 2 * /id
M5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(at :assignee | coalesce "unassigned") * count
M6: * /labels | flat | * lower | distinct | sort
M7: :d /dependencies | d | keys * (:k / | {:name (k | keyword) :version (d | at k | if (startsWith "^") ~(drop 1) ~(if (startsWith "~") ~(drop 1) ~(/)))}) | sort ~/name
M8: filter ~(/status | [(eq "paid") (eq "shipped")] | any ~(/)) | * /items | flat | * (mul /qty /price) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100
M9: filter ~(/status | ne "cancelled") | groupBy ~/customer | :g / | keys * (:c / | {:customer (c | keyword) :total (g | at c | * (/items * (mul /qty /price) | sum) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100)}) | sort ~([(/total | mul -1) /customer]) | take 2
M10: /services | filter ~(/tls/enabled !| false | eq true) | :s / | keys * (:k / | s | at k | [/host (at :port | coalesce 80 | print)] | join ":")
M11: lines | filter ~(split " " | at 1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(split " " | /2) * count
M12: lines | filter ~(split " " | at 1 | [(eq "WARN") (eq "ERROR")] | any ~(/)) | filter ~(lower | contains "timeout") | * (split " " | /2) | distinct | sort
M13: lines | drop 1 | * (split ",") | filter ~(at 2 | coalesce "" | ne "") | * {:dept /1 :sal (/2 | parseJson)} | groupBy ~/dept * (/ * /sal | :v / | sum | div (v | count) | round)
M14: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. The dog sleeps; the fox runs. A fox is quick." | split " " | * (lower | if (endsWith ".") ~(take (count | sub 1)) ~(if (endsWith ";") ~(take (count | sub 1)) ~(/))) | groupBy * count | :g / | keys * (:k / | {:word (k | keyword) :count (g | at k)}) | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /word]) | take 3
